If any case fails, fix the production module named by the traceback (smallest change, defaults bit-identical), add a regression assertion, and describe it in findings. Then rerun FEAT-001's golden tests.

(2) IN models have no BN layers: L.batch_norm_layers == [], Trainer._bn_layers == [], set_bn_stats_frozen returns 0 (so main.py's resume freeze re-apply is a no-op), checkpointing._restores_needed False (no snapshot/restore ops). (3) Parser: --level 1 --cascade-from x --norm instance --bn-recal-batches 0 parses (also with --bn-recal-freeze true = no-op); --bn-recal-batches 64 exits '--bn-recal-batches > 0 needs --norm batch, got --norm instance'. (4) Streaming exact for IN (per image): StreamedLevel vs model at L4/L2, float32 max u 2.1e-6 vox / A 2.6e-7, mixed_float16 max u 2.3e-3 / v_raw 4.8e-3 / A 9.7e-4 (bounds 1e-4 / 2e-2 / 1e-2), config A and B, chunks 1/2/N; predict.py check-streaming on an IN L2 cascade passes (fwd max 4.9e-5 mm); predict.py run --branches affine+deform --tta flip8 --recenter 1 exit 0, 0 non-finite, centrality 0.0225 -> 5e-5 mm. (5) From-scratch L1 (no --cascade-from) works in main.py: config.json has no cascade record, cascade_from None, bn_recal_batches 0, no bn_recalibration event; --task-start-step delays the task (task curve rigid,rigid,affine,rigid with affine:2); resume with the same run name continues at step 4 (PARAMETER records resumed False/0 then True/4, model_config unchanged, ckpt last-6); also with --norm instance --group-config none. The from-scratch L1 Trainer (cascade None, _n_stages 0, three tasks, float32_fine, AMP, adamw, lean sampler/losses, pair recompute, min pairs n, delayed deform) applies linear steps and traces the deform step for configs B/batch and none/instance. LOCAL LIMITS (GTX 1080, 6000 MB; not code bugs): the L1 deform TRAIN step OOMs even at TINY_L1 (IN chain test: Cast in the step function) and the L1 deform VALIDATION OOMs (warped one-hot in _deform_errors_chunked), so L1 deform steps are traced, not executed, and the main.py L1 runs train rigid+affine only (deform-only knobs float32_fine / ckpt full / lean sampler / lean losses / pair recompute / val chunks are parser errors without 'deform' in --task-ratio, so they are covered by the parser + Trainer tests).
